library.description: Framed avatar image surface showing a character's portrait from an image source, with optional status glow state.
Horizontal filled bar showing value within 0..max; fill fraction is value/max clamped to 0-1.
Compact alphanumeric readout showing a single stat value (number or text) with optional delta/modifier indication; no caption of its own.
Selectable/unlockable node on a progression tree; reports press to spend a point, exposes locked/unlocked/available state and rank progress (rank within maxRank).
Single equipment/cyberware slot surface holding at most one item; reports clicks to equip/unequip and drop targets. Empty when item is null.

props.item: { id: string; name: string; rarity?: string; icon?: string } | null

library.description: Grid selection of inventory items; each cell shows the item's icon, name, quantity and rarity tier. Reports the selected item id and a separate activation (equip/use) action.

props.items: { id: string; name: string; icon?: string; rarity?: string; quantity?: number; category?: string }[]

library.description: Read-only detail block for one selected entity: name, rarity/type line, description text and a list of stat name/value pairs.

props.name: string
props.stats?: { label: string; value: number | string; delta?: number }[]

library.description: Segmented row of mutually exclusive category options; emits the chosen option id.

props.options: { id: string; label: string; count?: number }[]

library.description: Single-line text input for filtering; emits the current query string on every change.
Momentary push button that fires once per press; face content supplied by the component.
Latching two-state switch; on reflects the current state and onChange emits the next state.
Vertical selection list of multi-field entries (title, category, level/difficulty, status); emits the selected entry id and an optional activation.

props.items: { id: string; title: string; category?: string; status?: string; meta?: string; tracked?: boolean }[]

library.description: Ordered list of objective steps with per-step completion/current state; read-only progress display.
Read-only display of reward entries (currency, xp, street cred, items) each with an icon/label and amount.

props.rewards: { id: string; label: string; amount?: number | string; icon?: string }[]

library.description: Pan/zoomable stylized map surface rendering region shapes and labels in its own normalized 0-1 coordinate space; positioned children are drawn in those coordinates.

props.regions: { id: string; label: string; path?: string; x?: number; y?: number }[]
props.onViewChange?: (view: { zoom: number; center: { x: number; y: number } }) => void

library.description: Point marker placed at normalized 0-1 map coordinates; reports its id on click and exposes kind/selected/active state.
Polyline path drawn over a map surface through a sequence of normalized 0-1 coordinates, marking the navigation route to a destination.
Stepped zoom control emitting the new zoom level within min..max.
Hover/focus-triggered floating info bubble anchored to its trigger element; content supplied by the component.
